prompt: Please generate an image. Locked painterly style (hand-painted, chunky readable shapes, detail painted not modelled, warm golden key light, cool teal shadows, muted saturation, epic and luminous, never grim). Use the attached image(s) only as reference as described; the first attachment is always the style reference for palette, rendering and light. Game-asset concept sheet, landscape 16:9, plain light neutral grey background, no scene, no sky, soft contact shadow only, every piece isolated with clear space and a small neat label underneath. Creature TURNAROUND sheet for 3D modelling: SHELLBACK CRAB, a broad crab with a shield-like shell grown over with tiny water plants and shells. Keep the exact design of the creature in the second attachment. Show front, side and back views in a neutral standing pose, a three-quarter action pose, and close-up callouts of head, feet or claws and a texture swatch of skin, fur, feathers or scale. Scale comparison: in one small separate box labelled SCALE, draw a 1.8 m human silhouette standing next to a small copy of the creature drawn at the SAME scale, so the creature is about 1 m across, reaching the human's hip; do not put the large human silhouette next to the big views.
